trigger: The U48 iteration-1 panel stood PASS/PASS/FAIL on a reproduced non-goal violation with every lens at verify_rounds 3, leaving no compliant record (DECISIONS #39).
lesson: An I41 re-poll is legal only for a lens with rounds to spare and that never tested the disputed finding; at 3 rounds no re-poll is legal, and escalation needs a FAIL majority.
how_to_apply: Before re-polling, read the lens's verify_rounds and tested scope; brief panel lenses to stop at 2 rounds when convergence allows, keeping one round for a possible re-poll.
